item.title: The One Reason Nintendo and Rockstar Can Make Games Like Ocarina of Time and GTA 6
item.description: Though wildly different in tone and scope, both Rockstar Games’ Grand Theft Auto 6 and Nintendo’s remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time exemplify the craft of making video games at its finest. Each one is redolent with attention to detail. Whether it’s the achingly nostalgic aesthetic of Ocarina or Rockstar’s Borg-like hive-mind of interconnected gameplay systems, there is a staggering amount of talent and dedication on display in these games. There are the kinds of endeavors that take years to pull off — and a company dedicated to helping its employees learn and grow over time. These are not the sort of games that can be produced by a company that lays people off every six months.

item.title: Harrison Ford’s 10/10 Action Thriller Is Leaving Streaming Soon
item.description: Harrison Ford has played plenty of memorable action heroes throughout his career, from Indiana Jones to Jack Ryan. But one of his most entertaining roles puts him in an especially unusual position: the Oval Office. In 1997's Air Force One , Ford plays a U.S. president who must take matters into his own hands when terrorists seize control of the plane carrying him and his family.

item.title: 10 Years Later, Netflix's $120 Million Flop Deserves a Season 2
item.description: This Turkey Day , as Polygon celebrates our favorite failures and flops from the world of entertainment, it's time to resurrect a Netflix original that earned (mostly) rave reviews but got canceled after just one season for what, in hindsight, feels like an easily avoidable reason. Not only is The Get Down an overlooked masterpiece, but 10 years later, it's due for a revival.

item.title: These Rare Pokémon Cards Are No Longer Eligible for PSA Grading
item.description: Mega Evolution returned to the Pokémon Trading Card Game with the launch of the Mega Evolution series in 2025. In this expansion, collectors can find extremely rare Mega Evolution Pokémon EX cards known as Mega Hyper Rare cards in English and Mega Ultra Rare cards in Japanese. These holographic secret cards show alternative artwork of Pokémon's Mega Evolutions on a beautiful gold-etched display.

item.title: Critical Role Officially Confirms a Fan-Favorite Episode Format Will Not Return
item.description: One of the best things about Critical Role ’s live shows is that, in many ways, they're a phenomenal way to address story threads the cast couldn’t get to by the end of the campaign. For example, The Mighty Nein Reunion: Echoes of the Solstice 2023 live show is set shortly after the Apogee Solstice, an event primarily associated with Campaign 3: Bells Hells but also directly affecting The Mighty Nein adventuring group, particularly Beauregard Lionett and Caleb Widogast.

item.title: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth Director Explains His Use of AI
item.description: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth takes place eight years after Once Upon a Time... in Hollywood and follows the life of stuntman Cliff Booth (Brad Pitt) after Rick Dalton (Leonardo DiCaprio) moves out of the country. Booth now performs dirty odd jobs for celebrities to keep himself afloat, and his life is just as exciting as it was before.

item.title: 20 Years Ago, The Sopranos PS2 Game Sank So GTA 6 Could Swim
item.description: Part of what makes Grand Theft Auto 6 feel like a major cultural moment is that there’s never been a game quite like it. There are plenty of open-world games that share a similar structure, but there’s very little in the way of big-budget sandbox crime simulators that balance rich storytelling with emergent chaos. If you want to play a game like GTA in 2026, your only real option is GTA.

item.title: 'Alien' Meets 'Vikings' in a 2008 Sci-Fi Spin on Beowulf That Deserves Redemption
item.description: Beowulf is one of the oldest surviving pieces of English literature, and its story of a hero defending the Danes from a monster has inspired numerous adaptations. John McTiernan told the story in his 1999 film The 13th Warrior, and Robert Zemeckis used motion capture for a 2007 version. But my favorite telling of the story eschews history and fantasy to turn the tale of Beowulf and Grendel into an Alien - inspired sci-fi action flick.

item.title: 51 Years Later, One of Peanuts’ Best Sally Brown Strips Is Still a Perfect School Joke
item.description: For years, one of the problems with reading Charles Schulz's Peanuts was the inconsistency among its collected editions . You'd think that Peanuts’ publishers, as the stewards of one of the most influential comic strips in the Western world, would simply reprint the comics in chronological order. It was rarely that simple.

item.title: The Lord of the Rings’ Next Movie Officially Wraps Production, but Now the Hard Part Begins
item.description: Warner Bros. announced on Nov. 25, 2026, that production on the next installment in The Lord of the Rings movie franchise has wrapped. The Hunt for Gollum , directed by Andy Serkis, is currently headed for post-production ahead of the movie's Dec. 17, 2027 release. The news follows Serkis' announcement in November that filming had ended .
